task_title: Load-brittle search suites: explicit bounded timeouts for FTS-building hooks
task_criteria: AC-1: each FTS-building search suite (src/search/search-retr001,search-retr007,search-retr008,hooks,search-freshness-dbgap047) declares an explicit bounded budget (hookTimeout/testTimeout 60s) scoped to that file; no global hookTimeout raise in vitest.config.ts. AC-4: tsc --noEmit clean and npx prettier --check src/ clean. AC-5: no new test files, AGENTS.md untouched.
